verdict.rationale: Native alerting is threshold-driven: triggers fire when thresholds you define are passed, and SLOs alert on budget burn against a target you set. The only outlier capability in the evidence is that AI agents connected through the MCP server can 'identify performance outliers' during investigation, which is on-demand analysis rather than enabled detection that surfaces problems on its own. missing for 10: a documented built-in anomaly/outlier detection feature, threshold-free alerting on detected anomalies, configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
